SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,ProductID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct 
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' 
AND (PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR  PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01') AND ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%') 
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId,ProductID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

SELECT BranchId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
GROUP BY BranchId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
HAVING COUNT(1)> 1

SELECT AccountID,BankSK,SourceSystemCode FROM DW.DimAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND CURRENTINDICATOR = 1
GROUP BY AccountID,BankSK,SourceSystemCode
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1


IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCTPROD_DEP') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCTPROD_DEP;
END;

WITH
AccountProductSK AS (
     SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountProductSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimAccountProduct
)


SELECT 
--ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM AccountProductSK) AS AccountProductSK
DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAFP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductID) AS ProductID
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBCH.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAFP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm    
--INTO DW.ACCTPROD_DEP             
FROM (SELECT CustomerAccountId,ProductID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND (PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR  PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01') AND ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%') GROUP BY CustomerAccountId,ProductID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId ) BCAFP
JOIN DW.FINLPRODUCTAPP FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionID = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN (SELECT BranchId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' GROUP BY BranchId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode) BCA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCAFP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAFP.FinancialInstitutionId) = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK,AccountID,BankSK,SourceSystemCode FROM DW.DimAccount WHERE CURRENTINDICATOR = 1) DDA ON BCAFP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDB.BankSK = DDA.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDA.SourceSystemCode 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ProductSK,ProductID,BANKSK,SourceSystemCode FROM DW.DimProduct WHERE CURRENTINDICATOR = 1) DDP ON BCAFP.ProductID = DDP.ProductID AND DDP.BANKSK = DDB.BankSK AND BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = DDP.SourceSystemCode  
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBCH ON BCA.BranchId = DDBCH.BranchID AND DDBCH.CURRENTINDICATOR = 1
where BCAFP.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
